messages:
Lina: seeing a spike of 403s for tenant t-6023 after the key rotation ~09:12 PT. dashboard shows auth-proxy errors increasing. anyone oncall?
Devon: i'm on. seeing same. auth-proxy fanout layer returning 502 -> 403 when calling introspect. sample curl reproduces 403: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood/v1/introspect` -> 403
AJ: looking at metrics — auth-fanout latency jumped from ~40ms to ~2.3s at 09:11. queue depth spiked, error rate lines up with rotation window. no obvious DB timeouts.
Lina: support ticket #54821 opened, multiple customers reporting permission denied even though tokens were valid pre-rotation.
Maria: did the JWKS rotation run? I see the rotation job completed at 09:10 but fanout logs show `invalid_kid` in several workers.
Devon: ok this fits: fanout caches JWKS per-tenant for 1h. rotation updated central JWKS but the fanout cache wasn't invalidated. tokens signed with new kid are rejected because fanout still uses the old key id.
AJ: repro steps: 1) request new token from auth-service (kid=k2_new) 2) call API through auth-proxy which calls fanout -> fanout validates against cached JWKS (k1_old) -> fails. log snippet:
```
ERROR auth-fanout worker-12: token verification failed: invalid_kid (expected kid: k1_old, token kid: k2_new)
```
Devon: mitigation: restart auth-fanout pods to reload JWKS caches. longer-term: rotation job must emit cache-invalidate events (or fanout should refetch on invalid_kid).
Lina: restarting pods now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-fanout-prod` — will watch.
sre-bot: deploy started by @Lina — rollout restart auth-fanout-prod — 5 pods
AJ: post-restart: error rate for t-6023 dropped to baseline within ~90s. other tenants look stable so far.
Maria: i'll create an RFC to add a canary gate to rotation and a cache-invalidate hook. assigning infra-team to implement.
Devon: open action items: [1] add cache-invalidate to rotation job, [2] fanout: on invalid_kid -> fetch JWKS fallback path + increment metric `auth.fanout.invalid_kid.count`, [3] add canary step to rotation pipeline, [4] postmortem if customer impact confirmed.
Lina: noted. support ticket updated with mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix. thanks team :heart:
support-bot: ticket #54821 updated: customer notified of mitigation; awaiting confirmation
sre-bot: Incident marked resolved. will auto-close in 24h if no regressions.
